title: A proper install window on macOS
summary: Opening Mugetsu.dmg now shows a laid-out install window: an eclipse background with an arrow guiding Mugetsu into Applications.

improvements.title: Eclipse install window
improvements.body: The macOS disk image opens on a dark eclipse background, Retina-sharp, with Mugetsu on the left, Applications on the right and an orbit arrow showing where to drag it.
